reference.reference_source: User-supplied intended lexical form; not a claim of correct acoustic realization
reference.observed_transcript_status: Native listener recognizes the intended utterance; exact segmental and tonal realization is not certified
reference.human_annotation: As a native Yorùbá speaker, I perceive the entire AI-generated utterance as unnatural. The entire utterance has an unusually nasal/nasalized quality, not merely the final word. The tonal/melodic realization sounds unnatural for Yorùbá. Some consonant/nasal portions appear unusually prominent or lengthened. Although the lexical content is recognizable, recognizable/correct text must NOT be treated as evidence of correct pronunciation.
reference.human_annotation_scope: Entire utterance; native-listener perception, not an acoustically proven diagnosis. Specific time intervals and annotator confidence have not been supplied.

human_annotation_history.text: Native listener reports unnatural tonal/melodic realization and unusually prominent/lengthened n-like or nasal realization.
human_annotation_history.scope: Earlier summary emphasized o ni and márùn-ún; do not interpret as limiting the observation to those portions.

reference.boundary_method: Existing unverified local CTC token events plus waveform/spectral envelope; events are anchors, not phoneme boundaries. No duration normalization.
